title: Calories
text: Log meals against the mission meal plan; the galley system can fill this in. There is no published limit; the trend against the personal baseline is what matters.
Sustained undereating with weight loss goes to the crew medical officer.
design_note: Baseline scoring only: no published single-reading limit.
